official_name: Sibaya Courtyard by Stone Wood Premier
address: H. No. 236/10 B, Khobra Vaddo, Baga, Bardez, North Goa 403515

description: Sibaya Courtyard by Stone Wood Premier is a newly opened 40-room courtyard hotel in Khobra Vaddo, Baga, part of the Goa-based Stone Wood Hotels & Resorts group. Every room has a private balcony, and the property offers a swimming pool, restaurant and free parking within easy reach of Baga Beach, Calangute Beach and the Tito's Lane nightlife strip.
highlights: Walking distance to Baga nightlife and beach
Direct-booking discounts offered by the operator
notes: Very new property (press coverage dated Sept 2026), so no guest reviews or Google rating were found yet. Name appears as both 'Premier' and 'Premium' across sources. Do not confuse with Sibaya Beach Resort in Morjim (same operator) or Sibaya Lodge in South Africa. Airport/station distances are locality-level figures for Baga Beach, not hotel-measured. Star rating is from the Agoda listing; the official site could not be fetched to confirm amenities beyond pool, restaurant and parking.

description: Calux Joia Do Mar Resort is a 40-room resort on the Calangute-Arpora Road in Porba Vaddo, a short drive from both Calangute and Baga beaches. The property is built around an outdoor pool with a swim-up bar and offers two restaurants, balcony rooms and free parking.
highlights: 5-minute drive to Baga and Calangute beaches
notes: OTAs classify this as a 3-star property, not 4-star. Guest reviews are mixed (Tripadvisor 3/5). Airport and station distances are Calangute locality figures; one OTA quoted 20.3 km to Dabolim which appears to be straight-line. Official site could not be fetched to confirm room categories.

description: Adamo The Bellus Goa is a 4-star hotel in Naika Vaddo, Calangute, set in tropical gardens within walking distance of Calangute Beach and market. highlights: Clove restaurant and bar with pool views
La Soin Spa and fitness centre
notes: Located in Calangute (Naika Vaddo), not Candolim. Room count varies by source: 117 (meeting-venue listings), 112 (Yatra) and 88 (Expedia); 117 used. Check-out time shown as 11:30 AM on Booking.com and 11:00 AM elsewhere. A toll-free number 1800-102-3266 is also listed.

description: Bells Beach Resort, run by Resort De Balneaire, sits in Porba Vaddo between Calangute and Baga, roughly a 15-minute walk from either beach. The resort offers 61 air-conditioned rooms, an outdoor pool with a children's section, a restaurant and bar, a gym and a complimentary daily manager's reception.
notes: Star rating conflicts: Expedia lists 3.5-star, Booking.com/ReadyToTrip list 4-star. Room count 61 (Expedia) vs 56 (Tripadvisor). Also trades as Resort De Balneaire (www.resortdebalneaire.com, additional phones 7709755003 / 0832-2950080). Mopa and Thivim distances are Calangute locality figures.

Pool with poolside bar and rooftop terrace

A separately listed 'Grandeur Sanchi Resort' on Expedia appears to be a duplicate listing with lower scores (6.6-7.6/10). Mopa and Thivim distances are Calangute locality figures.

Family-friendly with kids' pool and play area
Close to Arpora Saturday Night Market and Baga nightlife

Thivim distance not published.

description: Sairaj Beach Resort is a 72-room resort in Naikawaddo, Calangute, about a kilometre from Calangute Beach and a few minutes' drive from Baga. notes: Star rating conflicts: Hotels.com/Booking describe it as 4-star accommodation while Expedia lists 3.5-star. Additional reservation mobile numbers listed: 7620003252, 9822182817. Mopa distance is a Calangute locality figure.

Closest of the group to Mopa airport (approx. 25 km)
Seven room categories including bathtub suite
Near Anjuna and Vagator beaches and nightlife
Free parking plus beach and airport shuttles
